purpose: Archive existing local source, drafts and evidence at the user's request to send all changes to Git
releaseDirectory: Kept exactly as remote S14. Stale local S12 discovery/index and all local release-directory overlays were excluded.
sourceState: Historical local source snapshot, not a new release candidate or reviewed editorial approval
draftApprovals: Existing draft and pending statuses are preserved. No new content or rights approval is inferred.
tests: No functional suites or benchmarks run for this archive. File inventory, byte comparison and common private-key/token pattern checks only. Existing raw source HTML CRLF/trailing whitespace and historical EOF whitespace are preserved byte-for-byte rather than rewriting evidence.
privateSigningMaterial: Not copied; no private key or common GitHub/OpenAI token patterns found in the selected source files
